x-m-el-sta-09.title: Zana jadawali mai yaudarar ido da tsayin sanduna
x-m-el-sta-09.goal: Ka zana da kanka domin ka ga cewa fara ma'aunin tsaye daga ƙima banda 0 yana sauya yadda rabon tsayin sanduna yake gani, sannan ka zaɓi sharuɗɗan jadawali na gaskiya.
x-m-el-sta-09.material: Tallace-tallacen wata na kayayyaki biyu kusan iri ɗaya ne: A ya kai 52, B kuma 56. Idan ana zana bayanan a jadawalin sanduna, ana iya fara ma'aunin tsaye daga wata ƙima s banda 0 (a yanke abin da ke ƙasa). Saboda haka tsayin sandunan da ake gani ya zama 52−s na A da 56−s na B. (Idan s=0, tsayin da ake gani 52 da 56 ne.)
x-m-el-sta-09.thinking.0: Bincika tasirin saitin ma'auni ga kwatancen gani
x-m-el-sta-09.thinking.1: Nemo ƙimomi da dama da suka cika sharadi
x-m-el-sta-09.thinking.2: Zaɓi hanyoyin gabatar da bayanai na gaskiya
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin s guda 3 daban-daban da za su sa sandar B ta bayyana aƙalla ninki 3 na sandar A. (s aƙalla 0 ne kuma ƙasa da 52.)
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.hint.0: Saka s=0, 40, 48, sannan ka nemo rabon tsayin da ake gani ga kowanne.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo kusan ƙimar s inda rabon ya fara zama 3 ko fiye.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.ok.c1: s aƙalla 0 ne kuma ƙasa da 52.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.fail.c1: s dole ne ya zama aƙalla 0 kuma ƙasa da 52.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.ok.c2: Sanda B tana bayyana aƙalla ninki 3 na tsayin sanda A.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.fail.c2: Tsayin B da ake gani (56−s) bai kai ninki 3 na tsayin A da ake gani (52−s) ba.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s1.explain: Idan s=50, tsayin da ake gani ya zama 2 ga A da 6 ga B, wato daidai ninki 3. Idan s ya fi 50 amma bai kai 52 ba, rabon ya fi girma. Tallace-tallacen ainihi 52 da 56 ne, kusan ninki 1.08 kawai, amma jadawali ya sa su bayyana dabam ƙwarai.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.prompt: Yaya ya kamata a gyara jadawali mai yaudara irin wannan domin ya zama na gaskiya? Zaɓi duk abin da ya dace.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.hint.0: Bambance ko kowace hanya tana taimaka wa mai karatu fahimtar ƙimomi daidai ko karkatar da ra'ayi gefe guda.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.hint.1: Domin tsayin sanda ya yi daidai da ƙima, daga ina ma'aunin tsaye ya kamata ya fara?
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.a: Zana ma'aunin tsaye na jadawalin sanduna tun daga 0
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.a: Ka zaɓi hanya mafi muhimmanci domin tsayin sanduna ya yi daidai da ƙimomi.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.b: A sa sandar B kaɗai ta zama launin duhu domin ta fito fili
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.b: Jaddada gefe ɗaya da launi yana ƙara karkatar da ra'ayi. Tambaya ta farko ita ce ko tsayin yana nuna ƙimomi da gaskiya.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.c: A matse alamomin ma'auni domin bambancin sanduna ya bayyana babba
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.c: Daidaita tazarar ma'auni domin ƙara bambanci wata hanya ce ta yaudara.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.d: Rubuta ainihin ƙimomi, kamar 52 da 56, sama da sandunan
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.d: Ka bar mai karatu ya duba ƙimomin kai tsaye maimakon tsayin sanduna.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.o.e: Idan an yanke ma'aunin tsaye, zana alamar yankewa domin sanar da mai karatu
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.r.e: Ka zaɓi hanya da ba ta ɓoye gaskiyar cewa an yanke ma'aunin ba.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.explain: A jadawalin sanduna, dole ne tsayi ya yi daidai da ƙima. Fara ma'auni daga 0, ko idan an yanke shi, nuna hakan kuma rubuta ainihin ƙimomi domin kada a yaudari mai karatu. Ƙara bambanci ta launi ko tazarar ma'auni karkatar da bayanai ne.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.acc.0: Fara ma'auni daga 0 da rubuta ƙimomi ya isa ya zama gaskiya. Zai fi kyau kuma a san yadda ake nuna ma'aunin da aka yanke.
x-m-el-sta-09.s.s2.acc.1: Ko an yanke ma'auni, nuna alama da rubuta ƙimomi yana hana yaudarar masu karatu. Idan zai yiwu, farawa daga 0 ya fi sauƙi.

x-m-el-sta-05.title: Jefa tsabar sau kaɗan da sau da yawa: sa’a ce ko an cuce?
x-m-el-sta-05.goal: Ka yi amfani da bayanan kwaikwayo don tantance tunanin gwajin hasashe: ko da rabo iri ɗaya ne, wahalar bayyana sakamako da “sa’a kawai” ta dogara da adadin maimaitawa.
x-m-el-sta-05.material: Jihoon ya jefa tsabar kuɗi ya ce, “Ina tsammanin an ƙera wannan tsabar ne don ta fi sau da yawa faɗowa a kan fuskar kai!” Ka gudanar da kwaikwayon kwamfuta don ganin sau nawa irin wannan sakamako zai faru da tsabar da ba ta da son kai (wadda fuskar kai da wutsiya suke da yiwuwar iri ɗaya). Sakamakon kwaikwayo: (a) An maimaita jefa tsabar da ba ta da son kai sau 10, sau 1000; a kusan 170 daga cikin gwaje-gwajen ne aka samu fuskar kai 7 ko fiye. (b) An maimaita jefa tsabar da ba ta da son kai sau 100, sau 1000; ba a taɓa samun fuskar kai 70 ko fiye ba. Ainihin sakamakon Jihoon su ne Yanayi A (fuskar kai 7 cikin jifa 10) da Yanayi B (fuskar kai 70 cikin jifa 100).
x-m-el-sta-05.thinking.1: Tantance yadda sa’a za ta iya bayyana sakamako.
x-m-el-sta-05.prereq.0: Ma’anar yiwuwar faruwa da maimaita gwaje-gwaje
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ne ya fi ƙarfafa hujjar iƙirarin Jihoon cewa “an ƙera tsabar don ta fi sau da yawa faɗowa a kan fuskar kai”?
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo wanne kwaikwayo, (a) ko (b), ya yi daidai da kowane Yanayi A da Yanayi B.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.hint.1: A kowane kwaikwayo, kwatanta sau nawa tsabar da ba ta da son kai ta ba da irin wannan sakamakon.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.a: Yanayi A. Samun fuskar kai 7 a cikin ƙaramin adadin jifa ne sakamako mafi ban mamaki.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.a: A cikin kwaikwayo (a), ko da tsabar da ba ta da son kai ta samu fuskar kai 7 ko fiye cikin jifa 10 a kusan 170 cikin gwaje-gwaje 1000. Sakamakon da yake faruwa akai-akai ba abin mamaki ba ne.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.b: Duk yanayin biyu sun samu fuskar kai 70%, saboda haka hujjojinsu suna da ƙarfi iri ɗaya.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.b: Ko da rabo ɗaya ne, bambancin adadin jifa yana sauya yiwuwar faruwar sakamakon ta sa’a. Kwatanta jadawalin kwaikwayo (a) da (b).
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.c: Babu ɗayansu da hujja ne. Tsabar da ba ta da son kai ma na iya faɗowa a kan fuskar kai 70% na lokuta.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.c: “Zai iya faruwa” da “yana faruwa akai-akai” ba abu ɗaya ba ne. A yanayin (나) sakamakon ya yi ƙarancin yiwuwa har bai faru ko sau ɗaya ba.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.o.d: Yanayi B. Ba a samu irin wannan sakamako ba a kwaikwayon tsabar da ba ta da son kai.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.r.d: Yayin da adadin gwaje-gwaje ya ƙaru, ka gano sakamakon da yake da wuya a bayyana da sa’a kawai.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s1.explain: Ko da tsabar ba ta da son kai, samun fuskar kai 7 ko fiye cikin jifa 10 yana faruwa akai-akai (kusan 17%); amma ba a samu fuskar kai 70 ko fiye cikin jifa 100 ko sau ɗaya ba a kwaikwayon. Ko da rabo ɗaya ne, yawan jifa yana ƙara wahalar bayyana sakamakon da sa’a. Wannan shi ne tushen tunanin gwajin hasashe.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.prompt: Bisa sakamakon Yanayi B, za ka iya tabbatar 100% cewa “an ƙera wannan tsabar don ta fi faɗowa a kan fuskar kai”? Rubuta hukuncinka da dalili.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.hint.0: Karanta sakamakon kwaikwayo (나), sannan ka rubuta jimla guda da ke bayyana yadda sakamakon yake goyon bayan ƙarshe cewa tsabar “an cuce ta.”
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi amfani da sakamakon kwaikwayo (b) a matsayin hujja, ka faɗi yadda irin wannan sakamako yake da ƙarancin faruwa da tsabar da ba ta da son kai.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Ba za mu iya tabbatarwa ba ...
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Hukuncinka ya bayyana yadda abin yake da shakku, maimakon “tabbatacce ba haka ba ne” ko “tabbas haka ne”?
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka yi amfani da sakamakon kwaikwayon a matsayin hujja?
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.0: Ba za mu iya tabbatarwa ba. Ko da tsabar ba ta da son kai, tana iya samun fuskar kai 70 da wuya ƙwarai. Amma wannan ya yi wuya a kira sa’a kawai, saboda haka akwai yiwuwar an cuce tsabar.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.1: Yana da wuya a faɗi da tabbaci. Yiwuwar tsabar da ba ta da son kai ta ba da wannan sakamako ta sa’a ba 0 ba ce. Amma ba a taɓa samunsa a kwaikwayon ba, saboda haka ya dace a yi shakku.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.2: Ba tabbatacce 100% ba ne. Ba a taɓa samun fuskar kai 70 ko fiye a jifan tsabar da ba ta da son kai sau 100 cikin kwaikwayo 1000 ba, don haka yana da ƙarancin faruwa da zai jawo shakku; amma yiwuwar cewa sa’a ce ba 0 ba ce.
x-m-el-sta-05.s.s2.model.3: Ba zan ce tabbatacce ne ba, amma wannan sakamako kusan ba ya faruwa da tsabar da ba ta da son kai, saboda haka akwai yiwuwar an cuce ta.

x-m-el-sta-10.title: Zana bayanan amsoshi da yawa a jadawalin kek
x-m-el-sta-10.goal: Nemo dalilin da ya sa ba za a nuna kaso na bayanan amsoshi da yawa a jadawalin kek ba, sannan ka zaɓi jadawalin da ya dace.
x-m-el-sta-10.material: A wata makaranta, an tambayi dukkan ɗalibai 100, “Zaɓi duk wasannin da kake so (ana iya zaɓar fiye da ɗaya),” sannan aka rubuta rahoto.
x-m-el-sta-10.thinking.0: Yi hukunci ko nau'in jadawali ya dace da yanayin bayanan
x-m-el-sta-10.thinking.1: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa jimillar ta wuce 100%
x-m-el-sta-10.thinking.2: Gyara ta da jadawali mai dacewa
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda marar daidai a rahoton.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.hint.0: Nemo abin da aka samu idan aka tara kaso huɗun.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.hint.1: Ka tuna cewa sassan jadawalin kek suna raba gaba ɗaya ba tare da juyewa ba.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.0: Ɗalibai 60 sun zaɓi ƙwallon ƙafa, 45 ƙwallon kwando, 30 wasan raga, 25 kuma tsalle da igiya.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.1: Kason ɗaliban da suka zaɓi kowane wasa shi ne ƙwallon ƙafa 60%, kwando 45%, wasan raga 30%, tsalle da igiya 25%.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.2: Idan aka nuna kaso a jadawalin kek, kusurwoyin sassan huɗun su ne digiri 216, 162, 108, da 90.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.3: Idan aka haɗa sassan huɗun, za su zama cikakken da'ira guda.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.line.4: Saboda haka za mu iya cewa 60% na ɗalibai duka sun zaɓi ƙwallon ƙafa.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 da 4 ne matsalar. An yarda da zaɓuɓɓuka da yawa, don haka ɗalibi guda ya zaɓi wasanni da dama; kaso sun zama 160%, kusurwoyin tsakiya kuma digiri 576, fiye da cikakken juyin da'ira (360 digiri). Layi na 5 daidai ne domin 60 cikin ɗalibai 100 sun zaɓi ƙwallon ƙafa.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.prompt: Wane jadawali ne ya fi dacewa domin nuna waɗannan bayanan da gaskiya?
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.hint.0: Bambance ko abubuwan jadawali sassa ne marasa juyewa ko ƙimomi dabam-dabam.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.hint.1: Bincika ko kaso na kowane abu yana da rabo ɗaya, ɗalibai 100.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.o.a: Raba kaso da 160 domin su zama 100%, zana jadawalin kek, ka bar take yadda yake
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.r.a: Idan ka canza ƙimomi, za su zama “kason amsoshi” maimakon “kason ɗalibai,” wanda bai dace da taken ba.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.o.b: Bar jadawalin kek yadda yake, ka rubuta “jimilla 160%” da ƙananan rubutu a ƙasa
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.r.b: Wannan ƙarin bayani ne kawai a jadawalin da ya karya ƙa'idar cewa cikakken da'ira yana wakiltar gaba ɗaya.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.o.c: Sauya jadawalin kek zuwa jadawalin sanduna, ka nuna a kowace sanda kason ɗaliban da suka zaɓi wasan
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.r.c: Ka zaɓi nau'in jadawali da zai iya nuna kowane wasa a matsayin abu mai zaman kansa.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.o.d: Raba ƙwallon ƙafa da “sauran,” zana kek mai sassa biyu, ka yi amfani da 45+30+25 ga sauran
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.r.d: Jimillar sauran ta zama 100%, amma hakan ya bambanta da 40% na ɗaliban da ba su zaɓi ƙwallon ƙafa ba. Ƙimomin da aka ƙirga sau biyu har yanzu suna ciki.
x-m-el-sta-10.s.s2.explain: A bayanan amsoshi da yawa, ɗalibi guda na cikin abubuwa da dama, don haka kaso na iya wuce 100%. A wannan hali, nuna kowane abu dabam da sandarsa ya dace da yanayin bayanan.

x-m-el-sta-07.title: Idan muka ƙara barci, maki za su ƙaru?
x-m-el-sta-07.goal: Bambance abin da bayanan alaƙa suke faɗa da wanda ba sa faɗa, sannan tsara binciken da ake buƙata domin tantance sanadi.
x-m-el-sta-07.material: An tattara matsakaicin lokacin barcin yau da kullum da makin jarabawar lissafi na ɗalibai 200. Idan aka zana maki a jadawali, sun bazu zuwa sama da dama, wato makin kan fi yawa idan barci ya daɗe. Ƙimar alaƙa kusan 0.6 ce. Ɗaliban sun rayu kamar yadda suka saba, kuma ba a sa kowa ya canza lokacin barcinsa ba.
x-m-el-sta-07.thinking.0: Zaɓi ikirarin da bayanai suke goyon baya
x-m-el-sta-07.prereq.0: Ma'anar jadawalin watsuwa da ƙimar alaƙa (alaƙa mai kyau, alaƙa marar kyau)
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk abin da za a iya faɗa daga waɗannan bayanan binciken kaɗai.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.hint.0: Bambance ko kowace jimla tana cewa “suna canzawa tare” ko kuma “canza ɗaya yana canza ɗayan.”
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.hint.1: Sake karanta wanda ya ƙayyade lokacin barci a binciken.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.a: Idan ka ƙara lokacin barci, makin kowa zai ƙaru
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.a: Kalmar “kowa” tana amfani da ɗabi'a ga kowane mutum. Wannan binciken ba gwaji ba ne da aka canza lokacin barci.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.b: Ɗaliban da suka fi yin barci suna da ɗabi'ar samun maki mafi girma
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.b: Ka fahimci ma'anar alaƙa, wato ɗabi'ar abubuwa su canza tare, daidai.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.c: Idan maki ya ƙaru, ɗalibai sukan fara yin barci da kyau
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.c: Ba za a iya tabbatar da fassarar akasin alkibla daga wannan bayanin kaɗai ba.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.d: Wataƙila akwai ɗaliban da suke yin barci mai tsawo amma makinsu ya yi ƙasa
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.d: Ka gane cewa ɗabi'ar ba ta bayyana iri ɗaya ga kowane ɗalibi ba.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.o.e: Wannan bayanin yana nuna babu alaƙa tsakanin lokacin barci da maki
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.r.e: Ƙimar alaƙa ta 0.6 ta yi nisa da rashin alaƙa (kusa da 0).
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s1.explain: Alaƙa tana nuna ɗabi'ar canzawa tare kawai, ba dalilin ba. Kuma tun da ɗabi'a ce, akwai ɗaliban da suka bambanta.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.prompt: Yaya ya kamata a tsara bincike domin gano ko ƙara lokacin barci yana ƙara maki (ko shi ne sanadi)? Rubuta jimla ɗaya ko biyu.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin wanda zai iya yanke shawarar lokacin barci maimakon barin ɗalibai su zaɓa.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda za a raba ƙungiyoyin biyu da za a kwatanta cikin adalci.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka tabbatar sauran abubuwan da ke shafar maki ban da lokacin barci sun bazu iri ɗaya a ƙungiyoyin?
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Tsarinka ba zai cutar da ɗalibai ba kuwa?
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.model.0: A raba ɗaliban bazuwar zuwa ƙungiyoyi biyu, a sa ƙungiya ɗaya kawai ta ƙara barci na makonni 2, sannan a kwatanta sauyin makin jarabawar ƙungiyoyin.
x-m-el-sta-07.s.s2.model.1: A raba ɗalibai masu kama da juna ta hanyar ƙuri'a, a sa ɓangare ɗaya kawai ya kwanta da wuri yayin da sauran yanayi iri ɗaya suke, sannan a kwatanta maki.

x-m-el-sta-08.title: Shin yawan ma'aikatan kashe gobara na nufin asara ta ƙaru?
x-m-el-sta-08.goal: Nemo layin rahoto da ya tsallake daga alaƙa zuwa sanadi, sannan ka sake rubuta shi bisa abin da bayanai za su iya faɗa.
x-m-el-sta-08.material: Wannan wani ɓangare ne na rahoton gobara na birni.
x-m-el-sta-08.thinking.2: Sake rubuta a matsayin jimlar da bayanan ke goyon baya
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda da bayanan ba sa goyon baya.
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.hint.0: Rarraba layukan bisa ko suna cewa “suna canzawa tare” ko “shi ne sanadi.”
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko wani abu zai iya sa yawan ma'aikatan kashe gobara da asarar kuɗi su ƙaru tare.
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.line.0: Ga kowace gobara, mun rubuta yawan ma'aikatan da aka tura da adadin asarar da gobarar ta haddasa.
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.line.1: Yawan ma'aikatan kashe gobara da aka tura yana ƙaruwa tare da yawan asara.
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.line.2: Saboda haka akwai alaƙa mai kyau tsakanin yawan ma'aikata da asara.
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka ma'aikatan da aka tura su ne sanadin ƙarin asara.
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.line.4: Domin rage asara, ya kamata mu rage yawan ma'aikatan da za a tura nan gaba.
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ya mai da ɗabi'ar ƙaruwa tare (alaƙa) zuwa sanadi, cewa ma'aikatan kashe gobara suna ƙara asara. Wataƙila babban gobara ce ke sa a tura ma'aikata da yawa, kuma asarar ta fi yawa. Layi na 5 shawarar manufa ce bisa wannan sanadi marar tushe, don haka ita ma ba ta da hujja. Layuka na 1 zuwa 3 suna faɗin abin da bayanai suka nuna.
x-m-el-sta-08.s.s2.prompt: Sake rubuta layi na 4 (“Saboda haka ma'aikatan da aka tura su ne sanadin ƙarin asara.”) a matsayin jimlar da bayanan za su iya goyon baya, sannan ka rubuta dalilin sauyin.

x-m-el-sta-01.title: Za Mu Iya Amincewa da Sakamakon Wannan Bincike?
x-m-el-sta-01.topic: Bayanai da samfuran bincike (son zuciya wajen zaɓe).
x-m-el-sta-01.goal: Zaɓi bayanan da kake buƙatar dubawa kafin ka karɓi sakamakon binciken samfurin a matsayin magana game da kowa, sannan ka sake rubuta jumla domin ta dace da iyakar waɗanda aka bincika a zahiri.
x-m-el-sta-01.material: Wani labari ya bayyana a jaridar makaranta. Take: 72% na duk ɗalibai 600 sun gamsu da abincin makaranta! Ƙaramin rubutu a ƙarƙashin labarin: Taƙaitaccen bincike: an tattara takardun tambaya 100, kuma an yi wa 72 daga cikinsu alama gamsuwa. Labarin bai faɗi wa aka ba da takardun ko ta wace hanya ba, ko kuma wace jumla aka yi amfani da ita wajen tambayar.
x-m-el-sta-01.thinking.0: Tantance bayanan da ake buƙata da waɗanda ba a buƙata don amincewa da sakamako.
x-m-el-sta-01.thinking.1: Lura da bambanci tsakanin waɗanda aka bincika da waɗanda da'awar ta shafa.
x-m-el-sta-01.thinking.2: Takaita da'awa domin ta dace da hujjoji.
x-m-el-sta-01.prereq.0: Ma'anar binciken samfurin da cikakken bincike (ƙidaya kowa).
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.prompt: Don yanke shawarar ko za a amince da wannan labari, zaɓi duk abin da dole ne ka tambayi ƙungiyar jaridar makaranta.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sanya ƙungiyar da labarin yake magana a kanta (ɗalibai 600 duka) kusa da mutanen da suka amsa a zahiri (takardun tambaya 100), sannan ka kwatanta su.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin yadda sakamakon zai bambanta idan an ba da takardun tambaya 100 iri ɗaya a gaban ɗakin cin abinci maimakon a zaɓe su daga jerin sunaye.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.o.a: Wane ɗalibai aka ba wa takardun tambaya 100, kuma ta wace hanya?
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.r.a: Ka nuna cewa hanyar zaɓen samfurin bincike na iya karkatar da sakamakon zuwa gefe guda.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.o.b: Ko ƙimar gamsuwa a irin wannan bincike na bara ma ta kai kusan 70%.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.r.b: Ko da ƙimar shekarar da ta gabata ta yi kama, hakan ba ya tabbatar da cewa tambayoyin 100 da aka tattara a wannan karon suna wakiltar dukkan ɗalibai.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.o.c: Ko tambayar ba ta nuna son kai ba ce, kamar “Ka gamsu?”, ko kuwa tana karkatar da mutane zuwa wani amsa
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi la’akari da cewa yadda aka tsara tambaya na iya sauya amsoshi.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.o.d: Rabon tambayoyin da aka dawo da su cikin waɗanda aka rarraba, da kuma irin ɗaliban da ba su dawo da tambayarsu ba
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi la’akari da yiwuwar ra’ayin ɗaliban da ba su amsa ya bambanta da sakamakon.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.o.e: Ko 72÷100 da gaske yana ba da kason 72% da aka nuna a labarin
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.r.e: Lissafin daidai ne. Amma daidaiton lissafi ba shi da alaƙa kai tsaye da ko samfurin binciken yana wakiltar dukkan ɗalibai.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.explain: Sakamakon na iya karkata dangane da waɗanda aka tambaya, jumlar da aka yi amfani da ita, da waɗanda ba su amsa ba. Kwatanta da ƙimar shekarar da ta gabata ko duba lissafin rabo mai sauƙi ba ya nuna ko samfurin ya wakilci jama’a.
x-m-el-sta-01.s.s1.acc.0: Ka nuna matsalar zaɓen samfurin da rashin amsa. Duba yadda aka tsara tambayar ma zai sa bayaninka ya zama cikakke.

x-m-el-sta-02.topic: Bayanai da samfuran bincike (son zuciya wajen zaɓe).

x-m-el-sta-02.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka muna ƙiyasta cewa matsakaicin lokacin kallon bidiyo na dukkan ɗaliban makarantarmu ma kusan sa’o’i 1.5 ne.
